name: bitbucket_repos
description: Lists the Bitbucket repositories this assistant may read, newest activity first, optionally filtered by part of the name. Use it when the user asks which repositories exist, needs a repository slug they do not know, or asks where the assistant may run pipelines. It does not show commits or pipelines (that is bitbucket_commits or bitbucket_pipelines). Returns one line per repository: slug | project | language | updated | what you may do, where 'bypass' means pipelines run at once and 'after Approve' means they wait for the user's click.

name.description: Part of the repository name to filter by (e.g. orders). Leave it out to list them all.

limit.description: How many repositories to show, up to 100 (e.g. 30).
